name: portable-workflow-core
description: Harness-agnostic automated multi-agent workflow core and module integration package

authority.shared_system_of_record: GitHub Issues and Superboard for configured project (e.g. Project #1 for Bavariance/polysimulator or custom project adapter)
authority.local_recovery_cache: ledger.json and decisions.json (machine-local crash-resilient restart recovery cache)
authority.preflight_inventory: preflight_evidence/ (manifest-based staging probe inventory and TTL tracker)

invariants.no_auto_merge: Transition to integration requires an explicit authorization record with verified provenance. Self-authorization and CLI default operator trust are strictly rejected.
invariants.no_auto_deploy: Deployment to production, main merges, or staging promotions cannot be authorized through issue comments or autonomous routines.
invariants.no_self_spawn_loop: Coordinator runs as a single bounded evaluation step. It emits recommendations and state transitions without self-spawning recursive execution loops.
invariants.no_credential_leakage: Balance and probe modules strictly redact email addresses, project IDs, account numbers, and API tokens.
invariants.head_bound_evidence: Git HEAD changes invalidate all head-bound QA evidence, criteria statuses, and proofs, resetting state to implementation.
invariants.explicit_per_criterion_evidence: Every criterion in acceptance_criteria must have status 'verified' and non-empty evidence before transitioning to 'done'.
invariants.github_proof_required: Requests cannot close to 'done' without a verified GitHub proof URL (PR, issue comment, commit SHA, or asset) matching repository.

project_adapter.py.role: Project configuration and environment adapter isolating generic workflow core from repository identities, Superboard numbers, and staging coordinates
outputs: ProjectConfig dataclass with staging and safety rules

coordinator.py.role: Single bounded coordinator entrypoint combining state, decision sync, preflight gating, normalized usage, and model routing

ledger.py.role: Durable request ledger utility, atomic crash-resilient recovery cache, and transition graph invariant enforcer
ledger.py.cli_command: python ledger.py [add | update | check | next | list | show | recover] [--ledger <path>]
outputs: Request state transitions, invariant verification, recovery queues

decision_workflow.py.role: Issue-based asynchronous human decision contract, strict provenance validation, and authored-comment exclusion registry
decision_workflow.py.cli_command: python decision_workflow.py [ask | ingest | reply | sync | show | list] [--decisions <path>] [--ledger <path>]
inputs: GitHub issue comments via gh CLI
outputs: Resolved human decisions, unblocked ledger requests, clarification prompts

preflight.py.role: Manifest-driven staging integration preflight gating (Dokploy staging compose, Supabase staging ref, Stripe test mode)
inputs: Task manifests, environment probes, service evidence JSON
outputs: PreflightResult (passed, blocked, not_applicable), probe status inventory

balance_loader.py.role: Sanitized, read-only subscription usage snapshot loader, multi-window constraint evaluation, and provider quota tracking

model_routing.py.role: Reset-aware and quota-aware model selector, near-reset Codex promotion, and compact EvidencePacket generator

github_plan_renderer.py.role: GitHub markdown plan, visual architecture, and evidence recap renderer for issue and PR comments
outputs: Formatted GitHub Markdown with badges and tables

superboard_adapter.py.role: Superboard execution adapter bridging portable coordinator with existing loop tooling (super-qa-dispatch.sh, super-board-run.sh, and super_board_runtime)
outputs: AdapterExecutionResult with exact-SHA binding, gate verification, and Telegram milestone

github_pr_gate.py.role: Deterministic GitHub PR status & review gate helper verifying CI checks, independent non-author approval, and exact-head review reuse
inputs: GitHub PR via gh CLI or API payload
outputs: PRGateEvaluation (PASSED, BLOCKED, PENDING) with detailed gate reasons

telegram_notifier.py.role: Portable Telegram workflow status notification adapter with strict deduplication, cooldowns, and one-sentence event reporting
inputs: CoordinatorPacket JSON, NotificationEvent CLI arguments, channel access/env
outputs: DeliveryReceipt (JSON or terminal summary), deduplicated Telegram messages

worker_backend.py.role: Real configured agent-CLI worker execution: takes a structured request/dispatch packet, builds a configured argv (shell=False), runs one agent CLI, and returns a structured head-bound evidence record. Fails closed on a missing command, a non-zero exit, an absent or unparseable structured result, an unmapped routing model, a head mismatch, a missing artifact, or a pass verdict with no executed check. There is no fixture fallback.
inputs: structured worker request (dataclass, object, or mapping)
outputs: WorkerOutcome (ok, stage, exit_code, command, head_sha, evidence, artifacts, blocked_reason, backend_name)

continuation_driver.py.role: Minimal continuation driver wrapping the existing adapter run_step over an explicit list of authorized request ids. Reloads ledger state every step, measures real progress, parks on blocked/error/decision/no-progress/awaiting-authorization, journals completed stages so a restart never repeats one, holds a fail-fast single-driver lock, and handles SIGINT/SIGTERM. Never merges and never deploys.

diagnostics.py.role: Comprehensive aggregate system, service, provider, request and host resource diagnostics. Exposes where problems lie, what is missing, distinguishes access from health and stale from failed, and asks the user only when true human authorization/preference/credential is needed with a deduplicatable question identifier.

file.description: Standalone file fixture adapter requiring zero external dependencies, no Veyyon CLI, and no network access.

veyyon.description: Native Veyyon harness adapter reading live subscription metrics from host daemon.

generic_cli.description: Generic adapter for external orchestrators (OpenAI Codex, Anthropic Claude, Claude Code, GitHub Actions, custom runners).

polysimulator.description: Explicit project adapter preserving PolySimulator staging DB ref (hgzyqmaanndcimnclxtv), Dokploy compose ID (TU7b_dY9l9_nCas6YBNwj), and strict production/main DB prohibitions.

generic_project.description: Configurable project adapter for arbitrary repositories (e.g. acme/demo-service) and safe unknown environments.
